intents.title: Persist per-path hashes with each snapshot
intents.statement: Every snapshot stores a path to blake3 map beside its ref, so classification can look up historical content without re-reading git blobs; older snapshots without hashes are simply unavailable evidence.

intents.title: Classify REWOUND, COMPOUND and UNATTRIBUTED
intents.statement: At turn begin, diff the expected tree E against the current tree C and match changed paths against snapshot history. All changed paths on one snapshot is REWOUND; mixed matches are COMPOUND; no match is UNATTRIBUTED. Multiple historical matches are marked ambiguous and the most recent wins.

intents.title: Write one aggregated receipt
intents.statement: A difference produces one receipt with verdict, matched snapshot, changed paths and turns possibly undone. Identical differences are receipted once, stored in state/rewind.json, capped at 20, and appended to the ledger as rewind_confirmed or rewind_possible.

intents.title: Carry receipts in the next briefing
intents.statement: turn.begin returns rewind_receipts and a rewind_notice, and the receipt never blocks the turn, never restores a file and never refuses a commit.

intents.title: Advance E to the full tree at turn end
intents.statement: turn ready and turn commit record the full current map as the expected tree, because sync can change .afwe sources after the touched set was computed. This prevents a false rewind on the next begin.

intents.title: Rewind list and check
intents.statement: afwe rewind list and afwe rewind check expose receipts and on-demand classification through the API and MCP.

intents.title: Document classification and receipts
intents.statement: TUTORIAL, SPEC, README, skill and the Rewind Receipt term describe the verdicts, dedupe, advisory behaviour and the E := C fix.
